standard-dialogue-before-throne-of-misce.player: My name is [Fremennik name], will you not let me through?

standard-dialogue-before-throne-of-misce.npc: I'm afraid the King won't give an audience to anyone except a worthy hero.

standard-dialogue-before-throne-of-misce.text: If the player has not completed Heroes' quest:

steps.npc: If you become a member of the Heroes' Guild, he will definitely grant you an audience.

standard-dialogue-before-throne-of-misce.player: I am a member of the Heroes' Guild; does that not show my worth?
